result.reason: The clause gives Company the required affiliate and M&A assignment carve-outs and bars Contractor termination upon a Company change of control. However, it does not prohibit Contractor from assigning to a Company competitor, so it does not reach the preferred position. It also does not reach the fallback because Contractor lacks a notice-only right to assign to a successor. The added prohibition on re-pricing goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and unnecessarily changes commercial rights, although the language is otherwise professionally drafted.
